scope: Personal Best A2, Units 5–6, Student’s Book pp. 40–57. The practice papers use these themes and core language at A1.

topics.title: Celebrations and clothes
grammar: Present simple for routines and facts: He wears a jacket to work.
Present continuous for actions now: He is wearing a blue jacket.
Days, dates and time: on Saturday, on May 12, at four.

topics.title: Hobbies and shopping
grammar: Can and can’t for ability: I can sing. Can you play the guitar?
Polite shop questions: Can I try it on? Do you have it in blue?
Simple questions with be, do and can.

topics.title: Homes and places in town
grammar: There is and there are: There is a desk. There are two chairs.
Some and any: There are some shops. Are there any parks?
Place phrases: next to, in front of, behind, under, between and across from.

topics.title: Quick verb review
grammar: Recognize common present and simple past forms in short everyday messages.
Use do/does, am/is/are and can to form basic questions.
For the wider class tense workshop, use your separate class notes. The advanced perfect and perfect continuous forms are outside these A1 mocks.

drills.title: Clothes, hobbies and routines
drills.instructions: Choose the best answer. Check the explanation after you finish.

questions.explanation: Usually describes a routine. Use wear with I.
Look draws attention to what Sofia is wearing now.
After can, use the base form.
Use on with a full date.

questions.prompt: At the shop, which question asks about size?
options: Do you have these in size 39?
questions.answer: Do you have these in size 39?
questions.explanation: Size 39 asks about the fit of the item.

questions.prompt: At a clothes shop, ‘Can I try it on?’ means ____.
options: Can I put it on to see if it fits?
Can I stand by the door?
questions.answer: Can I put it on to see if it fits?
questions.explanation: Try on is used to check how clothes fit.

drills.title: Homes and town
drills.instructions: Choose the best answer. Check the explanation after you finish.

questions.prompt: There ____ two windows in the room.
questions.explanation: Use there are with a plural noun.

questions.prompt: Are there ____ chairs in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: Any is common in questions with a plural noun.

questions.prompt: The book is ____ the bag. Open the bag to find it.
questions.explanation: You open the bag because the book is inside.

questions.prompt: The café is next to the station. Where is it?
questions.explanation: Next to and beside mean the same here.

questions.prompt: My room has a bed, a lamp and a desk. Which can you study at?
questions.explanation: A desk is furniture you can sit at to study.

questions.prompt: NOTICE: The market closes at 2 p.m. today. You need to go ____.

interview: What do you do after school?

individual.prompt: Talk about a room where you like to spend time.

pair.prompt: You and your partner have free time on Saturday. Talk about the choices. Ask your partner what they like, give a reason and choose one together.

rubric: Grammar and vocabulary. Use familiar words and sentence patterns that express your meaning.
Pronunciation. Speak clearly enough for your partner and teacher to follow.
Interaction. Listen, respond, take turns and ask at least one question.
Development. Add a reason, detail or example when you can.
